semanticRuntimeSelections.ownership: The validated managed-cpp-int32-rethrow-owner-v1 contract retains one primary payload across two explicit propagation/handling entries. Each eligible handler entry releases once; only the final reference frees the original payload.
semanticRuntimeSelections.errorContract: Only the admitted generated integer throw/rethrow carriers participate. Outer handler selection precedes inner cleanup; new throws from handlers, termination, native C++ unwinding and CLR-error conversion are unsupported.
semanticRuntimeSelections.threadContract: The primary owner and propagation entries remain on their creating managed thread; no ambient current-handler registry or thread-local exception pointer is substituted.
semanticRuntimeSelections.callbackContract: No native entry or callback is supplied; actual handler-context tokens select the retained handling entry.
